title: Command Mechanism (Os/Plugin/App/Mode) With Footer Command Panel
description:
Introduce a command mechanism in ui, framework, etc. A command is scoped at os, plugin, app, or mode level (no window-level commands — tools and actions remain window-scoped). Commands may emit operations (VCS-tracked document changes). Introduce a command panel in the footer that shows all commands, categorized with categories expanding like tabs; when a command needs input, show the input form inside the command panel on the next hierarchy level above the command.

Plan approved and on disk at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-a-command-mechanism-refactored-harp.md. Key points: rename ActionResult->InvocationResult as a mechanical prerequisite; add CommandDefinition/CommandScope/CommandRef to framework/core/rs; add handle_command to the plugin trait/ABI (WIT + guest + host + TS bridge); remove ModeDefinition.actions in favor of ModeDefinition.commands; add a commandPanel slice + resolveCommands registry + os built-in commands + footer wiring in framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx; add a CommandPanel region to ui/js/react/index.tsx; migrate one app to real commands as reference (presentation app-scope, lowpoly mode-scope); extend existing test files only.
summary: Converted the bespoke footer CommandPanel into a real Panel anchor="bottom-middle", per the user's explicit choice for full literal reuse over a visual-only-parity alternative. Deleted the CommandPanel/CommandPanelProps/CommandPanelCategory/CommandPanelCommand component and its inline tests from ui/js/react/index.tsx (no ui-react code needed anymore — Panel/Tree/TreeDataItem already cover everything). Added buildCommandCategoryTree/buildCommandCategoryTabs in os-shell.tsx: each command category becomes a PanelTabLeaf (namespaced id command.category.<id>) whose content is a lazily-resolved TreePanelDefinition — zero-arg commands are fire-and-forget tree rows, arg-carrying commands toggle an exclusive expandedCommandId and reveal a synthetic arg-form section (TreeDataItem.control rows, no more Field wrapper) with Execute/Reset. Content reads expandedCommandId/stagedArgsByCommandId from refs at render time so defaultDock's memo (and therefore dock-skeleton persistence) never depends on per-keystroke arg-staging state. Wired commandCategoryTabs into defaultDock.anchors["bottom-middle"] (previously always empty). Trimmed CommandPanelState to just expandedCommandId/stagedArgsByCommandId (dropped activeCategoryId — category active/fold state is now the bottom-middle anchor's own generic SET_PANEL_VISIBLE/SET_PANEL_PATH, the same actions the four corners already use); removed the SET_COMMAND_CATEGORY action/reducer case; replicated the old collapse-expanded-on-category-switch behavior explicitly in buildPanelProps's onActiveTabPathChange for anchor="bottom-middle"; migrated the ShellSearchDialog arg-carrying-command palette redirect to the new anchor actions. Footer is now genuinely empty (no centered command item) — Layout's existing generic per-anchor Panel rendering picks up bottom-middle automatically. No Rust changes: CommandDefinition/CommandScope/ResolvedCommand untouched; conversion happens entirely in os-shell.tsx from already-resolved commands. Verified: framework-renderer-react 159/159 passing (added reducer + buildCommandCategoryTree/Tabs tests); ui-react 257/271 passing with the exact same 14 pre-existing unrelated failures as baseline (confirmed no regression); ui-react typecheck unchanged at 75 pre-existing errors (no new ones). Storybook/dev-preview visual verification was not possible — the Browser pane's navigate tool was unresponsive/timing out throughout this session on both external and internal URLs, an environment issue unrelated to this change.
